title: Staff email to users
summary: Staff, volunteers and students can email MyAPES Account users from the workspace: compose Service or Optional messages, pick recipients, preview and confirm, then send through a queued, rate-limited pipeline with no-reply branding, consent-aware Optional mail and campaign history.
changes: Added staff.messages.send, staff.messages.send.all and staff.messages.history.view permissions with default grants for staff, volunteers and students (own-module send) and administrators (including send.all).
Added Staff › Messages compose, draft save, recipient picker (all, group, module or individuals), preview with opt-out counts and typed confirmation for large or all-user sends.
Queued SendStaffMessageJob with per-sender daily and global per-minute rate limits, campaign delivery totals and OutboundMailLog rows per recipient.
Registered the staff.staff_message mail template with a no-reply From line, login footer and, for Optional mail, RespectsMailPreference plus signed unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe headers.
Added read-only campaign history (own messages for senders; all for administrators) with flash feedback, status badges and AuditLogger events for queued sends.
affected_areas: Authorization matrix and PermissionNaming Core catalogue
Outbound mail templates, Optional contact preference and unsubscribe
Queue workers and staff-messages rate limiter
version_rationale: Minor: new staff email campaign capability without breaking VERSION or module-runtime contract semantics.
validation: PHPUnit StaffMessagePermissionsTest and StaffMessageFlowTest; php artisan test --filter=Staff (351 passed).
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after the release commit.
known_limitations: Optional mail opt-out is the Email contact preference only; a fuller Privacy page arrives in a later milestone.
Campaign history stores subject and body for staff review; per-recipient OutboundMailLog remains metadata-only.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag (v0.70.0). activate-release syncs that package's changelog files and sets current to its VERSION. Staff message tables remain additive and unused after rollback.
provenance: Epic #499 with children #500–#509; milestone PR #982 on branch milestone/v0-71-0-staff-email-users.
